topic: 核心语法突破：非谓语动词全阶精讲与专练 (Non-Finite Verbs)
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：非谓语动词就像动词的“变身假面”。在一个英语简单句中，只能有一个真正的“谓语动词（主角）”。如果还想使用其他动词，就必须让它们变身，放弃做谓语，转而去充当主语、宾语、定语或状语。
2. 【口诀与公式】：
   - 不定式 (to do)：表“目的、未发生、将来”。公式：want / decide / plan + to do sth.
   - 动名词 (doing)：表“习惯、正在进行、抽象概念”。公式：enjoy / finish / mind / avoid + doing sth.
   - 分词 (doing / done)：表“特征或状态”。doing 表示主动与进行，done 表示被动与完成。
3. 【中小学避坑指南】：
   - 误区一：混淆 stop to do（停下来去干别的事）与 stop doing（停止当前正在做的事）。
   - 误区二：介词后面漏加 -ing（如 look forward to doing 中，to 是介词，必须用 doing！）。
   - 误区三：分词作状语时搞错逻辑主语的主被动（主语发出动作用 doing，主语承受动作用 done）。
4. 【经典例句】：
   - 例1 (P4-P6)：I enjoy reading storybooks in the school library. (我喜欢在学校图书馆读故事书。)
   - 例2 (P5-F2)：He turned off the TV to focus on his homework. (为了专注于作业，他关掉了电视。)
   - 例3 (F3-F5)：Hearing the national anthem, all students stood straight. (一听到国歌，所有学生都挺胸站立。)

questions.question: My younger brother enjoys ______ to English songs after school.
questions.explanation: 考查动名词作宾语。enjoy 后需接动词-ing 形式作宾语，表示“喜欢做某事”。故选 A。

questions.question: We decided ______ to the botanical garden this Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式作宾语。decide 后面习惯接不定式（to + 动词原形），即 decide to do sth.。故选 B。

questions.question: Don't forget ______ off the lights when you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: 考查 forget 搭配区别。forget to do sth. 意为“忘记去做某事（尚未做）”；forget doing sth. 意为“忘记做过某事”。离开前关灯属于尚未做的动作，故选 B。

questions.question: Thank you very much for ______ me with my math project.
questions.explanation: 考查介词后接动名词。for 为介词，介词后面后接动名词（v-ing）形式。故选 C。

questions.question: It is necessary for elementary students ______ healthy breakfast every day.
questions.explanation: 考查形式主语句型。“It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.” 中，It 为形式主语，真正的主语是不定式短语（to eat...）。故选 B。

questions.question: Look! The heavy rain has stopped. Let's go out ______ football.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式作目的状语。句意为“出去是为了踢足球”，不定式短语 to play 表示目的。故选 C。

questions.question: My parents don't allow me ______ video games on school nights.
questions.explanation: 考查动词不定式作宾补。allow sb. to do sth. 意为“允许某人做某事”。故选 B。

questions.question: Peter spends about 40 minutes ______ the piano every evening.
questions.explanation: 考查 spend 固定用法。spend time (in) doing sth. 表示“花费时间做某事”。故选 A。

questions.question: The strict teacher made all the pupils ______ the passage twice.
questions.explanation: 考查不带 to 的不定式。使役动词 make 后接裸不定式（动词原形）作宾补，即 make sb. do sth.。故选 C。

questions.question: All the children are looking forward to ______ the science museum next week.
questions.explanation: 考查含介词 to 的固定短语。look forward to 中的 to 为介词，后面必须接动名词形式 visiting。故选 B。

questions.question: The cartoon movie was so ______ that the kids couldn't stop laughing.
questions.explanation: 考查分词形容词区别。amusing 意为“令人发笑的/有趣的”，修饰物（movie）；amused 意为“感到有趣的”，修饰人。故选 A。

questions.question: The students stopped ______ as soon as the headmaster walked in.
questions.explanation: 考查 stop 搭配区别。stop doing sth. 表示“停止做某事”；stop to do sth. 表示“停下来去干另一件事”。根据情景“校长进来后学生停止说话”，故选 A。

questions.question: My grandfather goes ______ in the community pool every morning.
questions.explanation: 考查 go doing 固定结构。go swimming / go shopping 表示“去进行某项体育或休闲活动”。故选 C。

questions.question: Little Alice found it challenging ______ a sentence in French.
questions.explanation: 考查形式宾语句型。在 “find + it + adj. + to do sth.” 中，it 为形式宾语，真正宾语是不定式短语（to write）。故选 B。

questions.question: The students felt very ______ in the robotic dog show.
questions.explanation: 考查形容词短语。be/feel interested in 意为“对……感兴趣”，描述人的感受。故选 C。

questions.question: ______ from the peak of the hill, the modern city looks extremely magnificent.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词作状语。句子的逻辑主语 the modern city 与 see 之间是被动关系（城市被观看），因此使用过去分词 Seen 作状语。故选 B。

questions.question: ______ all his research tasks, the scientist left the laboratory with relief.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词的完成式作状语。逻辑主语 the scientist 与 finish 为主动关系，且“完成研究”发生在“离开实验室”之前，需用完成式 Having finished。故选 B。

questions.question: The boy ______ by the window reading a novel is our new classmate.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词作后置定语。standing by the window... 作后置定语修饰 the boy，主语与 stand 是主动且动作正在发生的逻辑关系。故选 A。

questions.question: She pretended ______ what her mother said and continued scrolling on her phone.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式的否定形式。pretend to do sth. 的否定表达是在不定式符号 to 前直接加 not，即 pretend not to do sth.。故选 B。

questions.question: With all the preparations ______, the host announced the grand opening of the event.
questions.explanation: 考查 with 复合结构。在 “with + 宾语 + 宾补” 结构中，preparations 与 complete 为逻辑被动且已完成的关系，应选用过去分词 completed。故选 B。

questions.question: The key issue ______ at tomorrow's international conference is about climate change.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式的被动语态作后置定语。issue 与 discuss 为被动关系，且根据时间状语 tomorrow's 可知动作发生在将来，故用不定式被动结构 to be discussed。故选 C。

questions.question: The applicant expressed deep regret for ______ the professor's recommendation letter in time.
questions.explanation: 考查动名词的否定形式。介词 for 后接动名词，否定词 not 加在动名词之前，构成 for not submitting。故选 A。

questions.question: ______ by professional tech reviewers, the new smartphone model achieved massive sales.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词作原因状语。逻辑主语 the new smartphone model 与 praise 为被动关系（手机受到好评），故选 A。

questions.question: The foreign minister entered the conference room, ______ by a team of experienced interpreters.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词作伴随状语。followed by... 表示“在……的陪伴/跟随下”，形容部长被翻译团队跟随的情态。故选 B。

questions.question: I distinctly heard someone ______ the piano in the music room when I walked past.
questions.explanation: 考查感官动词搭配。hear sb. doing sth. 强调听到某动作正在进行（当时路过时正在弹奏）。故选 C。

questions.question: ______ which road to take at the intersection, the driver stopped to ask a local resident.
questions.explanation: 考查分词短语的否定作原因状语。逻辑主语 the driver 与 know 是主动关系，否定词 not 须置于分词前端，构成 Not knowing。故选 A。

questions.question: Rather than ______ time playing online games, she chose to read classical literature.
questions.explanation: 考查固定句型。rather than（宁愿……而不……）后面接裸不定式（动词原形），即 rather than do sth.。故选 B。

questions.question: The dishonest officer was made ______ for his illegal actions in front of the public.
questions.explanation: 考查被动语态中的不定式还原。主动语态 make sb. do sth. 转变为被动语态时，省略的 to 必须还原，即 be made to do sth.。故选 B。

questions.question: ______ by experts for months, the ancient artifact was finally proved to be genuine.
questions.explanation: 考查完成被动分词作状语。逻辑主语 ancient artifact 与 examine 为被动关系，且“检测”发生在“证明”之前并持续数月，故用 Having been examined。故选 A。

questions.question: There is no point in ______ over past mistakes; we should focus on the upcoming challenge.
questions.explanation: 考查固定高考/中考常考句型。“There is no point in doing sth.” 意为“做某事毫无意义”，介词 in 后接动名词 crying。故选 B。
